text:
marta: Heads-up — preview for a new dedicated pool: L6e-48 (edge-optimized, 48GB) launching next week in FRA (eu-central-3) and SFO (us-west-1). Targeting low-latency streaming inference and small-batch realtime workloads. Pilot quotas will be granted to SRE, Platform, and a handful of pilot customers. Please don't @everyone yet; invites will go out tomorrow. :megaphone:

devon: Nice — how does it compare to A10G on latency/cost?

marta: Quick summary: ~20-30% lower median tail latency at 256–512 token slices, ~1.8x throughput/card vs A10G on our standard suite. Estimated unit cost ~0.65x per token (depends on batching). Full perf run + trace links will be in the doc I’ll post after deploy.

sre-alex: Any special scheduling/affinity requirements? preemptible? what about KV cache behavior?

devon: It's non-preemptible for Dedicated reservations. Edge pools have stricter locality (rack-level affinity) so we recommend pinning critical routes. KV cache warmup behaves like other 48GB variants — we instrumented the warmup and it looks stable. Example autoscale snippet for the pool: 

```\npool: l6e-euc3\nmin_replicas: 2\nmax_replicas: 24\nscaling_policy:\n  - metric: p95_latency\n    target: 150ms\n    cooldown: 45s\n```\n
ops-bot: Reservation created by marta: pool=l6e-euc3 count=24 start=2054400000 end=2055080000 (preview-reservations).

cecilia: Will this be in the Dedicated product (reserved capacity) or just warm/burst for hosted accounts?

marta: Both. Preview will accept Dedicated reservations for committed customers (SLA as discussed) and a small warm/burst slice for hosted customers to try. For enterprise quotes, Sales can include L6e as an option — ping me for recommended pricing bands.

raj: Note: preview quota increases are timeboxed to 2 weeks. If you need extensions, file infra-requests with justification + expected qps. Also please tear down any test reservation after 72h if not actively used.

samira: Billing note — preview will be billed at trial rate (internal cost center credit). When GA, standard dedicated tariff applies. We'll post a migration guide for customers who pilot on preview.

marta: Action items: 1) SRE & Platform: sign up for pilot by EOD Friday (form link in #devex). 2) Eng teams: avoid long-running synthetic jobs on preview pool. 3) Sales: hold pricing conversations until we post the perf deck. Will follow up with perf doc + rollout schedule later today. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
